chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'That which is prohibited due to blood relationship is also prohibited due to breast-feeding.'
ai.seo_question: What is the legal equivalence between blood relatives and milk relatives in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from al-Kafi articulates the foundational juristic principle that the legal effects of milk-kinship (al-rida'ah) mirror those of blood-kinship (al-qarab), a concept central to Shia fiqh regarding marriage prohibitions. It underscores the permanence of these bonds, establishing that the same degrees of relatives prohibited for marriage due to lineage are equally prohibited due to nursing, thereby clarifying the scope of mahram relationships in social and familial interactions.
